name: Website trust brief
summary: How long a website's domain has been registered (registration date and registrar from RDAP) and whether AI crawlers may read its home page under its robots.txt, in one answer.

rules: registration comes from RDAP; crawler access from the site's robots.txt as checked today
a run counts only when at least two verified pearls answered (the domain lookup and the readiness check)
every statement keeps its source link

terms.basis: API page header: free endpoints with no key or signup, fair use only; heavy or automated traffic may be throttled
section What you may not do: using the service to build a competing audit product and republishing reports; a site-trust necklace is close enough to count (PM rule: unclear means prohibits)

notes: v1 candidate (100-necklace plan 7-2, workflow 11-15). Leads are verified pearls 52559 (domain.lookup, RDAP) and 132732 (website.ai_readiness, xfix.ai); both passed the relay check at 11:41-11:46. 132732 answered in 12.6 s through the relay, so the crawlers slot gets the whole 5 s budget and may need a longer one after the tuning round. Fallbacks rdap-domain and site-readiness are planned until ops approves them. The task is graded whole (retest.grade_site_task): the RDAP registration date and a crawler verdict that agrees with robots.txt read when the case is graded. 11-15 (agent team terms check): 132732's terms prohibit a competing audit product, so it never runs and our own site-readiness leads the crawlers slot once ops approves it as a substitute.

input_help.domain: The website's domain without https://, for example python.org.
